duration: Saturdays in October and November (fall) or April and May (spring)
pay_detail: Not stated. No cost is listed on the page.
name: King Conservation Science Explorers (middle school)
what_you_do: Middle school students do hands-on STEAM projects on Saturdays at the zoo and nearby places. They share a final talk. The 2026-27 theme is being a responsible consumer.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 8. Letters of recommendation are not needed but are welcome.
deadline_text: Applications open twice a year: September 1 to October 1 and March 1 to April 1. The fall 2026 window has closed. Years for future windows are not printed on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the yearly application during an open window. You share your interests and recent wins. You also share your goals for college and a career.
notes: For younger teens. Eighth graders are encouraged to apply to King Scholars at the high school level. Cost is not stated on the page.
